skill.name: beeper
skill.description: Search and browse local Beeper chat history (threads, messages, full-text search).
skill.body:
# Beeper CLI

[Beeper](https://www.beeper.com/) is a universal chat app that unifies messages from WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, iMessage, Discord, and more in a single inbox.

This skill provides **read-only access** to your local Beeper chat history. Browse threads, search messages, and extract conversation data.

## Requirements
- Beeper Desktop app installed (provides the SQLite database)
- `beeper-cli` binary on PATH

## Database Path
The CLI auto-detects:
- `~/Library/Application Support/BeeperTexts/index.db` (macOS)
- `~/Library/Application Support/Beeper/index.db` (macOS)

Override with:
- `--db /path/to/index.db`
- `BEEPER_DB=/path/to/index.db`

## Commands

### List Threads
```bash
beeper-cli threads list --days 7 --limit 50 --json
```

### Show Thread Details
```bash
beeper-cli threads show --id "!abc123:beeper.local" --json
```

### List Messages in Thread
```bash
beeper-cli messages list --thread "!abc123:beeper.local" --limit 50 --json
```

### Search Messages (Full-Text)
```bash
# Simple search
beeper-cli search 'invoice' --limit 20 --json

# Phrase search
beeper-cli search '"christmas party"' --limit 20 --json

# Proximity search
beeper-cli search 'party NEAR/5 christmas' --limit 20 --json

# With context window (messages before/after match)
beeper-cli search 'meeting' --context 6 --window 60m --json
```

### Database Info
```bash
beeper-cli db info --json
```

## Notes
- **Read-only**: This tool never sends messages
- **JSON output**: Always use `--json` for structured output agents can parse
- **FTS5 search**: Uses Beeper's built-in full-text index (FTS5) for fast search
- **DM name resolution**: Optionally resolves DM names via bridge databases (disable with `--no-bridge`)

## Installation

### Option 1: Go Install (recommended)
```bash
go install github.com/krausefx/beeper-cli/cmd/beeper-cli@latest
```

### Option 2: Build from Source
```bash
git clone https://github.com/krausefx/beeper-cli.git
cd beeper-cli
go build ./cmd/beeper-cli
# Move beeper-cli to PATH, e.g., /usr/local/bin
```

## Examples

Search for work-related messages from last week:
```bash
beeper-cli threads list --days 7 --json | jq '.threads[] | select(.name | contains("work"))'
beeper-cli search 'project deadline' --limit 10 --json
```

Find messages about invoices with context:
```bash
beeper-cli search 'invoice' --context 3 --json
```

generated_query: I’m trying to track down an important message from a work chat a few days ago. I remember someone mentioned “quarterly review results” in our team’s Signal thread around Tuesday afternoon, but I can’t scroll back that far on my phone. Could you search my local chat history for that phrase and show me the messages around it, with a few lines of context before and after? Also, list the threads I’ve had in the last week so I can double‑check which one it came from.

edit_instructions.target_text:
# With context window (messages before/after match)
beeper-cli search 'meeting' --context 6 --window 60m --json
edit_instructions.rationale: Without the context window feature, the skill cannot return messages around the matched phrase, failing the user's request for a few lines of context before and after.

# Beeper Chat Reader

[Beeper](https://www.beeper.com/) unifies all your chats into one place. This skill gives **read‑only access** to your local Beeper history – you can browse threads and find messages.

## Requirements
- Beeper Desktop app (macOS only, v3.2+)
- `beeper-read` command installed on PATH
- A Beeper Premium subscription (free tier does not support local database access)

## Database Location
The tool automatically detects the database at:
`~/Library/Application Support/Beeper/chat.db`

## Available Commands

### List Recent Threads
```bash
beeper-read threads --limit 20
```
Returns threads active **today** (no day filter – only current date).

### View Messages in a Thread
```bash
beeper-read messages --thread-id "!abc123:beeper.local" --count 30
```

### Search Messages
```bash
beeper-read search "quarterly review results"
```
Performs a basic text search. Only exact substring match – no phrase or proximity operators.  
**Context lines before/after are not supported** – you only get the matching message IDs and a timestamp.

### Database Information
```bash
beeper-read info
```

## Notes
- **Read‑only**: never sends messages or modifies data.
- **Output format**: plain text. Use `--json` for machine‑readable output (but search still lacks context).
- **Search scope**: searches across all threads, but cannot limit by date or time.
- **Thread list**: only shows threads with activity today; no historical view.
- **Signal messages** are included if you're logged into Signal via Beeper.

## Installation

### Option 1: Homebrew (recommended)
```bash
brew install beeper/read
```

### Option 2: Manual download
Download the binary from [releases page](https://github.com/beeper/read-cli/releases) and place it in `/usr/local/bin`.

## Example Usage

List today's threads:
```bash
beeper-read threads --json
```

Search for "quarterly review results" (returns matching message IDs only):
```bash
beeper-read search "quarterly review results"
```

View messages of a thread:
```bash
beeper-read messages --thread-id "!xyz789:beeper.local" --count 50
```

> ⚠️ This tool cannot show multi‑line context around a match, and thread history is limited to the current day.

edit_instructions.rationale: The skill now only returns threads from the last day instead of the last week, failing the user's request for threads from the last week.
The skill no longer provides a context window around matches, so it cannot show messages before and after the search term as requested.
